_doc: EXAMPLE exterior district compiler spec — a 400x280 sand lounge pocket on the west shore, below D7 park and west of D8's boardwalk. Compile with: python3 scripts/compile-exterior-district.py --spec data/city-specs/biome-specs/beach.json. Vocabulary (biome / surface / slot / role / density / palette / interact) comes from data/limezu-visual-catalog/placement-rules.json. Format: docs/EXTERIOR-COMPILER.md

compiler._doc: coords 'local' = every rect/point below is relative to bbox, so the whole pocket relocates by editing bbox alone (see EXTERIOR-MISTAKES.md #4, stale bbox after relocate). 'world' is the default for districts authored in absolute coordinates.

label: SAND LOUNGE

surfaces._doc: the sand shelf covers the WHOLE bbox: pass A snaps sizes up to the tile grid, and any surface that stops short of the bbox edge leaves a sliver of bare world grass (see structure-grammar.md)

surfaces.name: promenade
surfaces._doc: paved approach along the north edge, down from the park

surfaces.name: access_ramp
surfaces._doc: ramp off the promenade onto the sand
thin waterline so the pocket reads as coast. Not paintable — pass A reserves it, pass H emits it as an animBand. D8's open sea sits east of x=3600.

slots.name: promenade_edge
slots._doc: benches / bins / a direction pole along the paved strip; nothing tall that blocks the view south

slots.name: lounge
slots._doc: the heart of the pocket: loungers, towels, parasols, palms

slots.name: wet_sand
slots._doc: shells, starfish, sea rocks, a float. Cells are derived by pass B from the sand/water boundary, so this slot follows the waterline wherever the water patch is moved to.

landmarks._doc: hero anchor; grp.beach.bamboo_bar will dress it with stools + drinks table once W1-C lands

groups._doc: recipe from data/limezu-visual-catalog/groups/ (W0-C): 12 pieces at tile offsets from the net's top-left. Never stamp me.beach.volley_net or the modular court-line tiles solo.

keep_clear.why: beach access corridor promenade -> waterline, must stay walkable

constraints._doc: walkability + coverage guards. A 400x280 pocket is 25x18 = 450 cells.
